Title
- Short, present-tense summary (e.g., "feat(llm): improve prompts")

Summary
- What changed and why
- Screenshots or logs if UI/telemetry changed

Testing
- Frontend: `cd fe-client && npm run lint && npm run build`

Checklist

- [ ] Updated docs where behavior changed
- [ ] CI passes (lint/tests)

Issues
- Closes #<issue-number>
